limitations: Edition, transcription source, publisher, and date are unresolved in tracked metadata.
The witness is simplified-or-mixed and is not a textual authority for canonical characters.
Earlier project documentation assigned it structural-reference status; punctuation use here is an explicit calibration experiment.
The available Wikisource comparison views provide character/structure alignment but no independent sentence punctuation.
No tracked record documents whether the local punctuation was manually edited.
qualification_basis: The file is byte-stable and its SHA-256 is recorded in tracked metadata.
It contains deterministic chapter/ordinal structure and punctuation-bearing paragraphs.
Exact-transfer analysis can compare stripped reference characters to canonical entry characters without changing either witness.
records.notes: Provisionally qualified for auditable punctuation transfer analysis only. It is not sufficiently identified or independently qualified to promote machine punctuation to trusted_reference_exact or story_reader_ready.
